name: description
label: Description
help: Leave it empty to keep the current description, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: coverFileId
label: Cover file ID
help: The ID of a file inside the gallery folder. Leave it empty to keep the current cover, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: zipDownload
label: Allow ZIP download
help: Visitors can download everything as a ZIP file.

name: password
label: Password
help: Leave it empty to keep the current password, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: expiresAt
label: Expires at
help: Leave it empty to keep the current date, or map `erase` so that the gallery never expires.

name: watermarkText
label: Watermark text
help: Leave it empty to keep the current watermark, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: active
label: Active
help: Turn it off to pause the gallery, or on to reopen it.
